Subject: Deferred commit revalidation & ownership roll-call

Team —

Finance flagged a set of opportunities marked 'Commit Deferred' or with close dates older than 45 days in Salesforce for this quarter. They want a clean reconciliation before the next forecast cycle. I attached a filtered snapshot (pipeline_snapshot_Q4-2026.csv) with the high-ambiguity rows up top. Please do the following by EOD Tue, Oct 6 (5:00pm PT):

- Owners: confirm "Realistic" (adjust close date or update stage), or mark as "At Risk / Archive".
- If ownership needs to change, reply with the new owner and reason.
- If you need a quick sync with the account, call it out and I'll book 15m.

Quick notes: the file highlights deals where the last activity was >30 days and the stage hasn't changed in >60 days. We're particularly concerned about STL-4721 (StellarHealth) — marked as Commit Deferred since Jul and still in 'Pilot' stage.

I appreciate short replies (I confirm / I need handoff / I will archive). Finance will escalate any un-validated deferred commits into an adjustment request on Oct 8.

— Markus

- Lauren: update ACME-998 close date after AE confirmation; transfer PHX-221 to Karthik if he accepts.
- Vanessa: set STL-4721 to At Risk and push to 2026-12-15; include your ops thread justification in SF comments.
